quotations.old_english: Gif gehádod man hine forwyrce mid deáþscylde
quotations.english: if a man in orders ruin himself with capital crime

source_text: deáþ-scyld, e; f. [deáþ death; scyld sin, crime] A death-fault, capital crime; capit&a-long;le cr&i-long;men :-- Gif gehádod man hine forwyrce mid deáþscylde if a man in orders ruin himself with capital crime, L. E. G. 4; Th. i. 168, 22; L. C. S. 43; Th. i. 400, 27.
